body.description: One REST GoogleAdsRow of Q-G4, the ad_group keyset scan (AAP 0.3.3): SELECT ad_group.id, ad_group.name, ad_group.status, campaign.id FROM ad_group, filtered to ad_group.status != 'REMOVED' and ad_group.id > {last_id}, ORDER BY ad_group.id LIMIT 9999. Each page holds at most 9,999 rows, below the 10,000-row page size, so no page can be silently truncated. The scan continues from the last ad_group.id while a page returns exactly 9,999 rows and ends on the first shorter page; ids strictly increase, so it terminates, and its union is the complete set of non-removed ad groups. Safe absence: sync infers that a tracked ad group was removed or disappeared only from a complete scan (ended on a short page, with no failed or deferred page); otherwise google.entities is incomplete for that sync and the previous snapshot stands. Used for keyword context and for C3b, which checks a cluster's head tokens against ad group names. The rows arrive in results[] of the search.json envelope, which governs the request body, headers and paging. Keys are camelCase and int64 values arrive as strings. Every resource with a selected field also returns its resourceName, the attributed campaign included. Undeclared keys fail validation, so a field added to the query must be declared here from the reference page first.

adGroup.description: The ad_group resource named in the FROM clause. Field types are transcribed from the v25 ad_group fields page and the v25 AdGroup reference.

resourceName.description: Immutable. The resource name of the ad group (RESOURCE_NAME), of the form customers/{customer_id}/adGroups/{ad_group_id}. Returned with every row although it is not selected.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the ad group (INT64), rendered as a JSON string; the parser converts it to an integer. Filterable and sortable, which makes it the keyset field: each next page filters ad_group.id > the last id seen.

name.description: The name of the ad group (STRING). Fewer than 255 UTF-8 full-width characters, with no null (0x0), line feed (0xA) or carriage return (0xD) characters. C3b tests a keyword cluster's head tokens against these names.

status.description: The status of the ad group (ENUM google.ads.googleads.v25.enums.AdGroupStatusEnum.AdGroupStatus). Q-G4 excludes REMOVED, but the enum keeps the reference page's full list, so a live capture or an unfiltered read still validates. UNKNOWN is a response-only value not known in this API version; UNSPECIFIED means no value was specified.

campaign.description: The campaign the ad group belongs to. campaign is an attributed resource of ad_group, so its fields are selectable with it and do not segment the rows. campaign.id is selected, so the row also carries campaign.resourceName.

resourceName.description: The resource name of the campaign (RESOURCE_NAME), of the form customers/{customer_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the campaign (INT64), rendered as a JSON string; the parser converts it to an integer. Links the ad group to its campaign row from Q-G2.
